about: Rules used by kolaboro.com/tools/late-handover/ in addition to the law notes in /tools/law/law.json. Every rule quotes the official text and links to it. General information, not legal advice.

es-loe-1999.publisher: Boletín Oficial del Estado (boe.es), consolidated text

rules.title: If the home is not delivered, the buyer can cancel and get the money back with legal interest, or agree a new date in writing
rules.plain: Under the first additional provision of Law 38/1999, if construction has not started or the home has not been delivered, the buyer may choose between cancelling the contract with a refund of the amounts paid on account, including applicable taxes, increased by legal interest, or granting the developer an extension, written into an additional clause with the new completion and delivery date.
rules.quote: Si la construcción no hubiera llegado a iniciarse o la vivienda no hubiera sido entregada, el adquirente podrá optar entre la rescisión del contrato con devolución de las cantidades entregadas a cuenta, incluidos los impuestos aplicables, incrementadas en los intereses legales, o conceder al promotor prórroga, que se hará constar en una cláusula adicional del contrato otorgado, especificando el nuevo período con la fecha de terminación de la construcción y entrega de la vivienda.
rules.translation: If construction has not started or the home has not been delivered, the buyer may choose between cancelling the contract with a refund of the amounts paid on account, including applicable taxes, increased by legal interest, or granting the developer an extension, which shall be recorded in an additional clause of the contract, specifying the new period with the date of completion and delivery of the home.

rules.title: The contract must say the developer will refund payments plus legal interest if the deadlines are missed
rules.plain: A Spanish contract that takes payments on account must state that the developer will return them, with taxes and legal interest, if construction does not start or finish within the agreed deadlines, or the occupancy licence is not obtained. It must also name the insurer or bank that guarantees this and the special account.
rules.quote: Que el promotor se obliga a la devolución al adquirente de las cantidades percibidas a cuenta, incluidos los impuestos aplicables, más los intereses legales en caso de que la construcción no se inicie o termine en los plazos convenidos que se determinen en el contrato, o no se obtenga la cédula de habitabilidad, licencia de primera ocupación o el documento equivalente que faculten para la ocupación de la vivienda.
rules.translation: That the developer undertakes to return to the buyer the amounts received on account, including applicable taxes, plus legal interest, if construction does not start or finish within the agreed periods set in the contract, or the certificate of habitability, first occupation licence or equivalent document allowing occupation of the home is not obtained.

rules.title: If the developer does not refund within 30 days of a formal demand, the buyer can claim from the insurer or bank
rules.plain: The buyer first demands the refund from the developer in a verifiable way. If the developer has not paid within thirty days, the buyer can claim from the insurer (who must pay within thirty days of the claim) or from the bank guarantee. A bank guarantee lapses if the buyer has not demanded cancellation and refund within two years of the developer's breach.
rules.cite: First additional provision, Two (Dos), 1 (h) and 2 (b) and (c)
rules.quote: En caso de que la construcción no se inicie o no llegue a buen fin en el plazo convenido el asegurado, siempre que haya requerido de manera fehaciente al promotor para la devolución de las cantidades aportadas a cuenta, incluidos los impuestos aplicables y sus intereses y este en el plazo de treinta días no haya procedido a su devolución, podrá reclamar al asegurador el abono de la indemnización correspondiente.
rules.translation: If construction does not start or is not completed within the agreed period, the insured, provided they have formally required the developer to return the amounts paid on account, including applicable taxes and interest, and the developer has not done so within thirty days, may claim the corresponding indemnity from the insurer.

legal_interest_es.note: Simple yearly rate. Each payment earns interest from the day it was paid to the refund date you choose, year by year at that year's rate.

ES.name: Spain
ES.summary: Spanish law gives the buyer of a home under construction a choice when it is not delivered: cancel with a refund plus legal interest, or a written extension. It sets no per-day penalty; that comes from the contract.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.summary: In a promissory contract with a deposit (sinal), if the seller fails to perform for a reason attributable to them, the buyer can demand double the deposit. A delay alone may not count as failure to perform; a lawyer decides that.

AE-DU.name: Dubai (UAE)
AE-DU.summary: The Dubai laws in our notes protect buyers' money through escrow and say what happens if a project is not completed. In the articles we have read, none sets a per-day or per-month amount for late handover, so the number comes from your contract.

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.summary: We have not yet read and verified an Indonesian article that sets delay compensation for pre-sales (PPJB). Government Regulation 12 of 2021 on housing could not be opened from the official legislation portals on 4 Nov 2026, so nothing from it is shown.

TH.name: Thailand
TH.summary: The Condominium Act sections in our notes cover foreign quotas and funds, not late handover. We have not yet verified a Thai rule that sets delay compensation.

OTHER.name: Somewhere else
OTHER.summary: We have no verified law notes on late handover for other markets yet. The contract calculation still works.
